{{Quote|Listen to me, you useless priss. Acolytes aren't allowed to murder each other. But accidents happen. It isn't murder without witnesses.|Dolgis|<ref name="TOR:AY" />}}
'''Dolgis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolyte]] at the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was an associate of [[Vemrin]], a fellow acolyte and an enemy of [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] [[Tremel]]'s [[Empire's Wrath|protégé]].

==Biography==
{{GameDS}}
{{Quote|Notice anything interesting? No witnesses. No witnesses means no rules.|Dolgis speaks to Tremel's protégé|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Vemrin and Dolgis had known each other from back on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], before they had been brought to the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]]. Dolgis stayed by Vemrin's side and helped him rise through the ranks of the acolytes. Together, they resented a [[Empire's Wrath|new acolyte]] who had been brought to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Academy by Overseer [[Tremel]] to stop Vemrin.<ref name="TOR" />

At Vermin's request, Dolgis [[Duel in the Korriban Academy (Dolgis)|ambushed]] the new acolyte on his way to Tremel's office. Dolgis talked about his belief that the lack of witnesses would let him get away with the [[Death/Legends|murder]] and told the other acolyte they would die. Dolgis engaged them, but lost. He begged for mercy from the acolyte, but received none.<ref name="TOR" />

In a later confrontation between the acolyte and Vemrin, the latter assumed that Dolgis failed because the former was still alive.<ref name="TOR:TFT">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|The Final Trial|Korriban}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith Warrior could choose to spare Dolgis earning Light side points or kill them earning Dark Side points.
